summary: The foreign issuer (Compañía Cervecerías Unidas S.A./United Breweries Co Inc) filed a Form 6-K reporting board and executive changes. Two directors resigned: Carlos Molina Solis (Vice-chairman, effective July 31, 2026) and Rodrigo Hinzpeter Kirberg (Director, effective June 30, 2026). Their replacements are Alexandre Othenio Carreteiro (Vice-chairman from Aug 1, 2026) and Patricio Jottar Nasrallah (Director from July 1, 2026), who steps down as CEO on June 30, 2026, with Eduardo Ffrench-Davis Rodríguez appointed as CEO from July 1, 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder involvement. The full board will be renewed at the next ordinary shareholders' meeting per Chilean law. Watch for operational continuity under the new leadership.
